title: Polypus: A Distributed Quantum Computing Library
description:
Polypus is an open-source distributed quantum computing library. It runs quantum circuits and trains variational quantum algorithms (VQE, QAOA, QML) across one or many QPUs, simulated or real, without changing the circuit code. The core is written in Rust for performance and correctness, and Python bindings via PyO3 make it a drop-in accelerator for existing Qiskit workflows.

Installed from PyPI as polypus-quantum, imported as polypus, and available on crates.io as polypus.
